_comment: Maps each ShipRow column to an ONC sensor. Used by app/sources/onc.py.
location: 'nav' = ONC_NAV_LOCATION_CODE (TWSB.N1), 'ship' = ONC_LOCATION_CODE (TWSB); any other value is used as a literal locationCode.
deviceCategory: ONC deviceCategoryCode. One scalardata/location request is made per (location, deviceCategory).
sensorCategoryCode: candidate codes, first match wins. Codes come from the TWSB inventory (Neon 'sensors' table); confirm with scripts/onc_discover.py.
unit: target unit. The value is converted from the sensor's unitOfMeasure (see UNIT_ALIASES/CONVERSIONS in onc.py). Omit to pass the value through.
checkAge: true = null when the sample is more than ONC_MAX_SENSOR_AGE_S older than the NAV sample (e.g. the seawater pump is off at the dock).
transform: optional change applied after the unit conversion. 'magnetic_to_true' adds MAGNETIC_DECLINATION_DEG and wraps to 0-360.
fallback: optional second sensor (same keys) read only when the first one has no usable value. Its group is requested only then.
The NAV group (location 'nav') is cached for ONC_NAV_CACHE_S, every other group for ONC_CACHE_S.

heading: NAV 'heading' is the ship's true heading (gyro). ORIENTATION 'magnetic_heading' is a fallback only: on 2026-08-17 it read 299-3 deg while the true heading went all the way round (compass deviation up to ~60 deg), so magnetic + declination is right within a few degrees at the Swartz Bay berth but ~40 deg off at Tsawwassen.
